challenge_scope_shape.name: challenge_scope_shape
challenge_scope_shape.value:
(
    ("challenge"."scope" = 'map' AND "challenge"."map_id" IS NOT NULL AND "challenge"."campaign_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("challenge"."scope" = 'campaign' AND "challenge"."campaign_id" IS NOT NULL AND "challenge"."map_id" IS NULL)
  )

map_hist_rating_valid.name: map_hist_rating_valid
map_hist_rating_valid.value:
(
    ("map"."hist_stars" IS NULL AND "map"."hist_sub_tier" IS NULL)
    OR ("map"."hist_stars" IS NOT NULL AND "map"."hist_stars" = 0 AND "map"."hist_sub_tier" IS NULL)
    OR ("map"."hist_stars" IS NOT NULL AND "map"."hist_stars" BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND "map"."hist_sub_tier" IS NOT NULL AND "map"."hist_sub_tier" IN ('lower', 'upper'))
  )

player_binding_code_method.name: player_binding_code_method
player_binding_code_method.value: "player_binding_code"."accepted_via" IS NULL OR ("player_binding_code"."accepted_via" IN ('signature', 'admin') AND "player_binding_code"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

submission_target_shape.name: submission_target_shape
submission_target_shape.value: "submission"."challenge_id" IS NOT NULL OR "submission"."proposed_target" IS NOT NULL

tracker_area_stats_known_value.name: tracker_area_stats_known_value
tracker_area_stats_known_value.value: "tracker_area_stats"."no_golden_best_deaths" IS NOT NULL OR "tracker_area_stats"."total_deaths" IS NOT NULL OR "tracker_area_stats"."completed" IS NOT NULL
